title: maint.event.v1{kind=maint_scaler_default_applied}
description: Phase 8 §8.16.1 — emitted once per process lifetime per unconfigured target by maint.scaler.v1 when an agent has no entry in cfg.maint_scaler_max_replicas_overrides_csv and the default-policy fallback (cfg.maint_scaler_default_max_replicas) is enabled (>0). Audit pair to sec.alert.v1{kind=maint_scaler_unconfigured_agent}. Notification-only — no consumer acks.
